rows.note: For a general organizational department, 部門 is the all-purpose choice, including when no specific institutional title is intended.

example.english: The company's department will move to a new office next month.
example.traditional: 公司嘅部門下個月會搬去新辦公室。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 ge3 bou6 mun4 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 bun1 heoi3 san1 baan6 gung1 sat1

rows.note: Use 局 for a Hong Kong-style government bureau or department when it has that official institutional status.

example.english: The Transport Department announced that fares will increase next week.
example.traditional: 運輸局宣布下星期起加價。
example.jyutping: wan6 syu1 guk6 syun1 bou3 haa6 sing1 kei4 hei2 gaa1 gaa3

rows.note: 部 is a shorter, more institutional form used especially in names or compounds for an organizational department rather than as the usual standalone choice.

example.english: Each government department has to follow the new guidelines.
example.traditional: 政府各部都要跟新指引辦事。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 gok3 bou6 dou1 jiu3 gan1 san1 zi2 jan5 baan6 si6

rows.note: Use 系 for an academic subject department in a university or similar institution, such as a physics or history department.

example.english: I'm studying in the physics department.
example.jyutping: ngo5 duk6 gan2 mat6 lei5 hai6
